text: Today's video, making a pizza. First, let's look at the ingredients. Mushrooms. Onion. Peppers. Cheese. Ham. Pepperoni. Pizza base. Tomato sauce. Next, let's learn how to make a pizza. First, chop the mushrooms, onions, and peppers. Then, grate the cheese. Next, heat oil in the pan. Then, cook for one minute. After that, add the tomato sauce and cheese to the base. Then, put the vegetables, ham, and pepperoni on top. Finally, cook the pizza in the oven for 15 minutes.
